messages:
Tamara (People Ops): Thanks again for joining the all-hands — recording + slides here: https://redwood.example.com/allhands-mar2026

Tamara (People Ops): Quick follow-ups from Q&A — please drop any unresolved asks here and we'll respond. Key items I promised to clarify:
- Promo timeline and packet template
- Leveling criteria vs peers
- Midyear comp / retention adjustments
- Benefits question about 401k match timing

Tamara (People Ops): Promo timeline (short): `Manager nominations: Mar 15-31
Calibration: Apr 10-14
Leaders sign-off: Apr 20
Effective date: May 1` — updated template is in #docs (see pinned message).

Eli: Quick Q — if my promo packet is in the current slate, can I still interview for an internal transfer? :thinking:

Tamara (People Ops): Yes — being in a promo slate doesn't block internal moves. If both processes progress, we'll coordinate timing so you aren't double-booked. Ping me if it gets messy.

Nadia: For calibration, are we judged strictly against the ladder or also against peer comp? trying to prep my writeup.

Chris: Also — is there a new promotion packet template or rubric we should use? I couldn't find the version referenced in the all-hands.

Tamara (People Ops): Use the updated packet in #docs — it includes a short rubric mapping examples to ladder levels. Calibration uses ladder + demonstrated scope/impact + market signals. Managers should attach 2–3 supporting examples.

Sam: Are there midyear comp adjustments, or is everything held for the annual cycle?

Tamara (People Ops): We do have a small midyear pool for exceptions/retention. Managers can nominate between Apr 1-15 for urgent cases. Broad adjustments still happen in Q4.

Tamara (People Ops): Benefits note: 401k match policy is unchanged; any timeline questions should go to benefits@redwood.example.com. We will plan a short explainer doc this week.

PeopleOpsBot: Office hours created — Thu Apr 4 11:00 PT. Calendar invites sent to people who reacted with :hand: in the all-hands thread.

Eli: thanks — will come with one specific scenario for timing.

Nadia: dropping my follow-ups here and will DM my manager.

Chris: thanks for the clarifications — will update my candidate packet template now.

Tamara (People Ops): Thanks all. If anything else comes up, reply here or book office hours. I'll post the recording + the packet link in #docs shortly. :thumbsup:
